title: Workplace Cafe Management Program Charge Schedule Footnote on the Exit Fee Base
content:
Where three or more management fee invoices stand on the contract in the six months up to the day the charge is raised and the highest management fee ever invoiced on the contract stands above the monthly management fee printed against the service model, the exit fee base is that highest management fee; where three or more management fee invoices stand over the six months up to the day the charge is raised and the highest management fee ever invoiced on the contract stands at or below the monthly management fee printed against the service model, the exit fee base is the mean of the management fees invoiced over the six months up to the day the charge is raised, rounded to the nearest cent; and where fewer than three management fee invoices stand over the six months up to the day the charge is raised, the exit fee base is the monthly management fee printed against the service model.

Only postings of the management fee kind on the cafe management contract's ledger count toward the 3, and only those falling in the six months up to the day the charge is raised. The highest management fee ever invoiced on the contract is read across the whole of that contract's ledger rather than across those six months alone.

| Standing of the contract's invoicing | Exit fee base |
|---|---|
| 3 or more management fee invoices over those six months, highest ever invoiced above the printed monthly figure | that highest management fee |
| 3 or more management fee invoices over those six months, highest ever invoiced at or below the printed monthly figure | the mean of the management fees invoiced over those six months, rounded to the nearest cent |
| fewer than 3 management fee invoices over those six months | the monthly management fee printed against the service model |

Hypothetically, for a site under the Workplace Cafe Management Program whose printed monthly management fee is 3120.00 USD: with management fee invoices of 3060.00, 3070.00 and 3120.00 USD standing over those six months and a highest management fee ever invoiced on the contract of 3120.00 USD, that highest figure stands at the printed monthly figure and so at or below it, and the exit fee base is the mean of those three invoiced fees, being 3083.33 USD once rounded to the nearest cent. Had the highest management fee ever invoiced on the contract instead been 3400.00 USD, it would stand above 3120.00 USD and the exit fee base would be 3400.00 USD.
